home.hero_sub: Find the welfare schemes you are eligible for, apply in a few steps, keep your documents safe and track every application, even without internet.
home.svc_verify_sub: Check an acknowledgement or sanction order
home.svc_data_sub: Spending and beneficiaries by scheme and state
home.how1_sub: Answer six short questions to see the schemes you qualify for.
home.how2_sub: Fill one simple form. Your progress is saved on your phone.
home.how3_sub: Keep documents in your wallet and reuse them in any application.
home.how4_sub: Follow every step and receive the benefit directly in your bank account.
schemes.title: Browse schemes
schemes.sub: Search and filter central and state welfare schemes.
schemes.search_ph: Search by name, benefit or category
schemes.empty_sub: Try removing a filter or searching with a different word.
elig.title: Check your eligibility
elig.sub: Answer six short questions. We will show the schemes you can apply for.
elig.private: Your answers stay on this device
elig.q_state: Which state do you live in?
elig.h_state: State-specific schemes depend on where you live.
elig.h_age: Enter your age in completed years.
elig.h_gender: Some schemes are meant for women and girls.
elig.q_income: What is your annual family income?
elig.h_income: Total income of all family members in a year.
elig.h_occupation: Choose the option that describes you best.
elig.h_category: This helps us find reserved schemes for you.
elig.results_title: You may be eligible for {n} schemes
elig.results_sub: Based on your answers. Final eligibility is confirmed after verification.
elig.none_sub: You can still browse all schemes or change your answers.
login.title: Sign in
login.sub: Use your mobile number. We will send a one-time password (OTP).
login.mobile_hint: 10-digit number registered with your bank or Aadhaar
login.err_mobile: Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
login.err_otp: Please enter all 6 digits of the OTP.
login.demo_sub: Tap a profile to fill the number, then enter any OTP.
auth.required_sub: Sign in with your mobile number to see your applications and documents.
dash.title: My dashboard
dash.complete_profile: Complete your profile to get recommendations.
dash.go_profile: Apply for a scheme to complete it
dash.recommended_sub: Schemes you appear to be eligible for and have not applied to yet.
notif.title: Notifications
queue.title: Waiting to send
queue.count: {n} submission(s) will be sent automatically when you are back online.
apply.title: Apply for scheme
apply.autosave: Your progress is saved on this device
apply.step_profile_sub: Check your personal details. They will be saved for future applications.
apply.step_questions_sub: A few questions specific to this scheme.
apply.step_documents_sub: Pick documents from your wallet in one tap, or upload new ones.
apply.step_review_sub: Please check everything before you submit.
apply.step_submit_sub: Confirm the declaration to submit your application.
apply.name: Full name (as in Aadhaar)
apply.income_hint: As shown on your income certificate
apply.not_eligible: Based on these details you may not meet all conditions:
apply.no_questions: This scheme has no additional questions. Continue to the next step.
apply.upload_sub: It will also be saved to your document wallet for future use.
apply.declaration: I, {name}, declare that the information given in this application is true and correct to the best of my knowledge. I understand that giving false information may lead to rejection of my application and recovery of any benefit paid.
apply.declare_cb: I agree to the declaration above
apply.offline_note: You are offline. Your application will be saved and sent automatically when you are back online.
apply.error: Something went wrong. Your draft is safe. Please try again.
apply.closed: Applications for this scheme are not open
apply.closed_sub: The scheme may be closed or temporarily paused.
apply.success_sub: Your application for {scheme} has been received. Keep the reference number below.
apply.queued_sub: You are offline. Your application will be sent automatically when you are back online, and you will get a reference number.
val.name: Please enter the full name (at least 3 letters).
val.dob: Please enter a valid date of birth.
val.income: Please enter your annual family income.
val.account: Account number should be 9 to 18 digits.
val.declare: Please agree to the declaration to submit.
track.title: Track application status
track.sub: All your applications and where they are now.
track.empty_sub: Check your eligibility to find schemes and apply.
track.action_needed: Action needed: please correct and resubmit
track.sanctioned_msg: Your application has been approved. The amount will be credited to your bank account soon.
track.credited_msg: {amount} has been credited to your account ending {acc}.
track.rejected_help: If you think this is a mistake, you can raise a grievance.
wallet.title: Document wallet
wallet.sub: Upload once, reuse in every application. Stored only on this device.
wallet.add_sub: Take a photo or choose a file. We will detect the document type.
wallet.too_big: File is larger than 8 MB. Please choose a smaller file.
wallet.empty_sub: Add your Aadhaar card, income certificate and bank passbook to apply faster.
wallet.confirm_delete_sub: It will be removed from this device. Applications already submitted are not affected.
grv.title: Grievances
grv.sub: Raise a concern about an application and follow its progress.
grv.subject: Subject
grv.desc_hint: Include dates and what you expected to happen.
grv.queued: You are offline. The grievance will be sent when you are back online.
grv.err_subject: Please write a short subject (at least 5 characters).
grv.err_desc: Please describe the issue (at least 15 characters).
grv.empty_sub: Grievances you raise will appear here.
profile.title: Profile and settings
profile.guest_sub: Sign in to apply, track applications and use your document wallet.
settings.dark_hint: Easier on the eyes at night
settings.notifications_sub: Get a notification when an application's status changes
settings.notif_unsupported: Notifications are not supported on this device.
settings.notif_test_body: Updates are on. We will notify you when your application status changes.
settings.install_sub: Add civicXindo to your home screen
settings.clear_sub: Removes saved drafts, queued submissions and cached pages
settings.clear_confirm_sub: Drafts and submissions waiting to send will be deleted from this device.
settings.reset_sub: Restores all schemes, applications and documents to the original demo state
settings.reset_confirm_sub: All changes made in this demo will be lost and you will be signed out.
install.title: Add civicXindo to your home screen
install.body: Open it like an app, even without internet.
install.fast: Opens instantly from your home screen
install.native: Uses little storage, no app store needed
install.manual: Use your browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
offline.banner: You are offline. Your work is saved on this device.
update.title: A new version is available
update.body: Refresh to get the latest improvements.
verify.title: Verify a document
verify.sub: Check whether an acknowledgement or sanction order was issued by civicXindo.
verify.ref_hint: Printed at the top of the document, e.g. CXI/2026/VSS/001041
verify.no_scanner: QR scanning is not supported on this device. Please type the reference number.
verify.no_code: No QR code found in the photo. Please try again or type the number.
verify.not_found_sub: Check the number and try again. If it still fails, the document may not be genuine.
od.title: Open data
od.sub: Anonymised totals of spending and beneficiaries. Updated continuously.
od.note: Demo data. Figures are illustrative. Generated {d}.
nf.title: Page not found
nf.body: The page you are looking for may have moved. Please use the menu or go to the home page.
sr.intro: civicXindo follows the Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and can be used with screen readers. The following free and commercial screen readers are known to work.
sr.caption: Screen readers
sr.k1: Press Tab on any page to reach “Skip to main content”.
sr.k2: Headings are structured so you can move between sections with your screen reader's heading navigation.
sr.k3: Status changes and messages are announced automatically.
gov.login_sub: Choose a demo account to sign in. Each role sees its own dashboard.
gov.demo_note: Demo only. In production, officials sign in with their government credentials and two-factor authentication.
gov.queue_sub: Oldest files first. Each file must be decided within 15 days.
gov.keyboard_hint: Tip: focus a file and press R to recommend or B to send back.
gov.swipe_hint: Swipe right to recommend, left to send back.
gov.queue_empty_sub: All files have been decided. New applications will appear here.
gov.comment_hint: Explain clearly what needs to be corrected.
gov.comment_required: Please write a comment of at least 10 characters.
gov.reason_hint: The applicant will see this reason.
gov.reason_required: Please give a reason of at least 10 characters.
gov.preset_s1: The document uploaded is not readable. Please upload a clear copy.
gov.preset_s2: The income certificate has expired. Please upload a current certificate.
gov.preset_r1: Applicant does not meet the income limit as per field verification.
gov.preset_r2: Duplicate application: benefit already received under this scheme.
gov.doc_specimen: Specimen document (demo). The original is held in the applicant's records.
gov.tamper_overlay: Possible tampering: font mismatch in amount field
gov.not_actionable: This file has already been decided and is shown for reference.
author.title: Scheme builder
author.sub: Create new schemes or revise published ones, then submit for approval.
author.none_sub: Start a new scheme or revise a published one.
author.revision_started: Revision started. The live scheme is unchanged until approved.
author.code_hint: 2–4 capital letters, used in reference numbers
author.rules_help: An applicant must meet every rule. Rules are checked automatically during eligibility and application.
author.fields_help: Questions asked only for this scheme, in addition to the citizen's profile.
author.docs_help: Choose the documents an applicant must attach.
author.preview_note: This is exactly how citizens will see the scheme page.
author.v_name: Please enter the English name (at least 4 characters).
author.v_tagline: Please enter a short description (at least 8 characters).
author.v_rules: Add at least one eligibility rule.
author.v_budget: Budget must be more than zero.
author.v_amount: Benefit amount must be more than zero.
author.v_dates: The last date must be after the opening date.
appr.title: Scheme approvals
appr.sub: Review new schemes and revisions side by side before they go live.
appr.empty_sub: Schemes submitted by authors will appear here.
appr.approved: {name} approved. It will go live after the Portal Manager publishes it.
appr.comment_hint: Tell the author what to change.
san.title: Sanction and pay
san.sub: Create payment batches from recommended applications and release them within the budget.
san.empty_sub: Files recommended by district officers will appear here.
san.after_batch: {p}% of budget used after this batch
san.over_budget: The batch total is more than the remaining budget.
cmd.title: Command view
cmd.sub: Budgets, fraud alerts, publication and people across the portal.
cmd.c2: Eligibility rules match the notified guidelines
cmd.self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
cmd.v_email: Please enter a valid email address.
cmd.head: Head of department
audit.title: Audit log
audit.sub: Every action on the portal: who did what, and when.
